auto_alert_rule.rule: Future alerts fire AUTOMATICALLY within each contract's window, without waiting for expert approval.
auto_alert_rule.detail: When the paper pipeline issues a qualifying signal, the paper-signal-alert-delivery worker emits SETUP_PENDING at qualification and ENTRY_CONFIRMED on entry observation — inside the contract's 15-minute entry window — on its normal 15m sweep, with no expert-approval gate. Expert review remains measurement/oversight; it is never a delivery precondition. Dossier-tracker rows are NOT alerted as actionable under this rule (see labeling_spec: DOSSIER vs PAPER paths).

discovery_mode_note: sweep-fallback: trigger hook not deployed; sweep keeps v2.1 full discovery with documented lateness. Parent flips to 'trigger-only' only after the hook is deployed AND one triggered delivery is proven end-to-end (triggered run -> outbox delivered -> ledger delivered with trigger_source=trigger). In trigger-only mode the sweep is recovery-only: fresh keys inside trigger_grace_s belong to the trigger; older fresh keys are delivered once via missed-trigger recovery.
